# Tokenization

**Read:** [CS336 L1](http://cs336.stanford.edu/spring2025-lectures/?trace=var/traces/lecture_01.json); [minbpe](https://github.com/karpathy/minbpe); [CS336 A1 handout](https://github.com/stanford-cs336/assignment1-basics/blob/main/cs336_spring2025_assignment1_basics.pdf)

**Must master:** BPE merge algorithm; WordPiece vs SentencePiece; pre-tokenization and Unicode normalization; why " hello" and "hello" differ; vocab-size trade-off (fewer tokens per sentence vs more embedding params); why bad tokenization hurts code and multilingual models

**HAND implementation:** BPE from a corpus, 45 min (Phase 2)

**Known interview question:** "Time complexity of the merge step?" "Why does tokenizer efficiency shift the Chinchilla frontier?"
